views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs."BowlerID",
  b."BowlerFirstName",
  b."BowlerLastName",
  bs."MatchID",
  bs."GameNumber",
  bs."HandiCapScore",
  t."TourneyDate",
  t."TourneyLocation"
FROM "Bowler_Scores" bs
JOIN "Bowlers" b
  ON bs."BowlerID" = b."BowlerID"
JOIN "Tourney_Matches" tm
  ON bs."MatchID" = tm."MatchID"
JOIN "Tournaments" t
  ON tm."TourneyID" = t."TourneyID"
WHERE bs."WonGame" = 1
  AND bs."HandiCapScore" <= 190
  AND t."TourneyLocation" IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
views.description: Task: Find all individual game records for bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at each of the three venues Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes, and return thos
